# First Greeting with Rina, the Town Resident

It looks like Arthur, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.

First Greeting with Rina, the Town Resident

Description
01 It looks like Arthur, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Henesys Town Hall.
Quest journal 03 ⌄ 02 Arthur, the town clerk, asked me to greet Rina, a resident of the town. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the townspeople is a given, right?
03 Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
04 I greeted Rina, a resident of Henesys. I have a feeling we're going to get along great!
NPC Dialogue
On accept
"Since you've become a resident of Henesys , it would be a good idea to go greet the people here. As it happens, I've been wondering how Rina is doing lately, so please go say hello to Rina .
- Arthur "
On completion
It's a beautiful day, isn't it? A stroll through Henesys would be absolutely perfect on a day like this. But what brings you here?
Pardon? You're saying you obtained citizenship in Henesys and became a resident? Oh my, that's wonderful news! Welcome to our town!
Let me formally introduce myself. I'm Rina . I absolutely love everything about this town, and my specialty is cooking. I'd love to treat you to my homemade grilled eel someday.
Living in such a beautiful town really feels like a dream. I'm sure this is all thanks to Athena Pierce and Chief Stan . Thank you so much for coming to say hello, and I look forward to getting to know you!
